crosses.outcome: Happiest Plants reports that seeds acquired from Eddy Pranoto at a Bangkok show grew into small seedlings, naming Blue Pap as mother and a BVEP × Dorito Portillae hybrid as pollen donor. This is seller-attributed breeder information, not breeder-direct confirmation.
crosses.uncertainty: Only the outer seed/pollen direction is source-reported; internal roles in the entire pollen hybrid are unknown. Source wording BVEP/Antolakii is preserved without authenticating identity or synonymy. Blue Pap remains an unresolved trade identity, with no pure-species assignment. No direct Blue Pap × BVEP event, intermediate success, adult outcome, fertility or connection to a user specimen is inferred. Crossing dates are unknown. Excluded from the successful-cross graph because compound parent identities are unresolved.
crosses.citation_detail: Source title: Blue Pap × (BVEP × Dorito Portillae) seller-reported seedlings | Original URL: https://happiestplants.com/products/anthurium-papillilaminum-blue-x-bvep-x-dorito-portillae

crosses.outcome: Rochani is described in an official Indonesian registration bulletin as originating from veitchii GCI 002 female × forgetii male. Plant and inflorescence descriptions support a reported grown/flowering plant endpoint.
crosses.uncertainty: Primary registry-published breeder parentage, not DNA confirmation or independent controlled replication. GCI 002 is the reported maternal accession; accepted species mapping is for retrieval and does not authenticate other accessions or user specimens. Crossing date, germination rate, functional fertility and reciprocal outcome are not established. Flowering is not functional fertility. Graph use is limited to attributed reported-outcome analogy, consistently with other explicit flowering reports; no probability or compatibility guarantee.
